title: Legal aid intake contact record (de-identified), version 0.1.0
description: One record per intake contact (an AI voice call, a staff phone call, an online or walk-in intake), for evaluating AI intake against a baseline across sites. Holds no direct identifiers: no names, phone numbers, addresses, birth dates, emails, transcripts or free-text notes. Licence: CC BY 4.0. By MV2 of Munim, Inc. Not legal advice.

record_id.description: Pseudonymous id assigned by the site (for example a keyed hash of the CMS id). Never the CMS id itself or a phone number.

site.description: Short code for the organisation, so two or more sites can share one file.

period.description: baseline = traditional intake before or alongside the pilot; pilot = while the AI intake is live.

date.description: Contact date only, no time of day.

after_hours.description: Contact came outside the site's staffed intake hours.

language.description: BCP 47 tag of the language the intake was conducted in.

consent.description: not_reached = the contact ended before consent was asked.

required_fields_total.description: Intake fields the site requires for this kind of matter.

required_fields_filled.description: Of those, how many reached the case management system populated.

disclosures.description: For AI contacts: whether each disclosure was delivered, as confirmed from logs or a sampled transcript.

safety_flag_ai.description: The AI raised a safety or urgency flag (for example domestic violence, a court date within days).

review.description: Filled only for contacts in the human review sample.

should_screen_in.description: The reviewer's call on whether the contact should have been screened in under the site's own priorities.

legal_advice_given.description: The AI gave specific legal advice (a reviewer finding).

data_errors.description: Fields the reviewer found wrong in the CMS record.

demographics.description: Banded only. Report breakdowns with small-cell suppression.

survey.description: Record survey offers for every outcome, including screened-out callers.
